source_change_scope: New independent childless diagnostic; original metadata producer, request, result and nonce are preserved.
R6 SourceContract and current guard remain exact original on-device files, reverified before/after.
Only original report and the one exact base.apk path authorize the APK observation.
The original first APK conjunction is decomposed into seven booleans; no old gate is changed.
No inherited Flow, PM command, app discover, classpath read, task action or APK hashing is called.
Caller-owned fixed init/proc/pidfd/six-namespace/root acquisitions are immediately journaled.
APK ancestors and leaf use O_PATH with O_NOFOLLOW, with held/named equality and final recheck.
Only existing action lock is opened O_RDONLY; one nonblocking flock and release, no wait/retry/create.
Exceptions preserve first error; final guard, name, FD close, or deadline failure prevents success.

borrowed_implementation_scope.source_contract: Unmodified fixed bytes; whole 14-file hash closure verified by original SourceContract.verify.
borrowed_implementation_scope.current_guard: Unmodified fixed bytes; fixed identities/user namespaces/owner chain/root/executable metadata/resource limits, no fresh discovery.
borrowed_implementation_scope.held_runtime: Unmodified proc_identity_at/pidfd_alive/NS_TYPES only; no entry or read_file.
borrowed_implementation_scope.helper_qualification: Original verify_shared_helper reads its pinned qualification; helper binary is not executed.
borrowed_implementation_scope.FD_claim: all_journal_FDs_closed covers this diagnostic's explicitly acquired descriptors; imported R6 helper close errors propagate. No whole-process ambient FD equality is asserted.
